N_enrolled.short_description: Number of kindergarten students enrolled at the reporting level.

rate_dtap.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination

rate_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
rate_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.

rate_personal_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_personal_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_full_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from every required vaccine
rate_full_exempt.short_description: Proportion of enrolled kindergarten students exempt from every required vaccine.
rate_full_exempt.long_description: ADHS publishes this as '% Exempt from Every Req'd Vaccine', so it counts students holding an exemption covering all required vaccines rather than students with any exemption from any single vaccine, and it is smaller than the medical and personal exemption rates combined. Reported from the 2015-2016 school year onward; earlier years are missing because the column did not exist.
rate_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were exempt from every required vaccine.
